description: The Order have discovered catacombs beneath Khabor’s Waystation far predating the Janists. What horrors are they unearthing in this ancient Labyrinth. Locate Bishop Roma deep below and find out! Venture through the doors before you to find out what is hidden below.
name: Into the Depths
